events.summary: Nirthu declares Ulamog dead and his brood dying.
events.quote: Ulamog is dead, and his brood is dying.

events.summary: Tolaria West bans temporal manipulation, teaching its students the value of time.
events.quote: It took the banning of temporal manipulation at Tolaria West to teach its students the value of time.

events.summary: Jhoira recalls that Dominaria itself became a weapon in a war for survival.
events.quote: In a war for survival, Dominaria itself became a weapon.

events.summary: Karn says Yawgmoth is dead and his citadels lie empty.
events.quote: Yawgmoth is dead, and his citadels lie empty.

events.summary: Lord Windgrace describes Yawgmoth's corpse as a wound infecting the land.
events.quote: Yawgmoth's corpse is a wound in the universe.

events.summary: Liliana views the attention of angels as testament to her power.
events.quote: Liliana viewed the attention of the angels as a testament to her power.

events.summary: Gisa tells her brother she has found new playmates beyond Ludevic.
events.quote: but I too have found some new playmates.

events.summary: Entire ways of life disappear in the collision of the shards.
events.quote: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

events.summary: A crowd cries that Avacyn has abandoned them and they have only what they can take.
Karn comments on Squee's immortality and Yawgmoth's curse.
events.quote: If Yawgmoth meant Squee's immortality as a curse, no one ever told Squee.

events.summary: Sorin Markov reflects on decadence of death for vanity and pleasure.
events.quote: This is the decadence I sought to curb.
